subject: Nuvera Health POC — evaluation approach, success gates, and owners
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire.thompson@nuverahealth.com>
Cc: Michael Ruiz <michael.ruiz@nuverahealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 13:15:00 -0400
Subject: Nuvera Health POC — evaluation approach, success gates, and owners

Hi Claire — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

What we heard from Nuvera:
- Primary use case: classifying incoming referral notes to identify priority patients and route to care coordinators (realtime-ish).
- Success needs: >=92% high-precision for "urgent" tags; sub-100ms average inference latency on 256-token window for routing path; clear audit logs and redaction for PHI.
- Constraints: Cannot send PHI off their VPC for initial evaluation; prefer private deployment for the shadow portion.

Proposed POC structure (high level):
1) Offline evaluation (2 weeks): Nuvera provides a labeled slice (~5k notes) — we run a blind offline evaluation against the rubric and return a granular scorecard.
2) Online shadow (48–72 hours): deploy Redwood Private in their staging VPC; mirror traffic (no routing to production) and measure end-to-end latency, throughput, and precision metrics.
3) Acceptance gate: pass offline scoring thresholds AND shadow precision within 3 percentage points of offline.

Ownership (proposal):
- Redwood sales lead / customer contact: Hannah Schmitt (I'll coordinate)
- Trial engineering / deployment: Aditya Rao (SE)
- Customer success / rollout readiness: Marissa Cole

Immediate next steps I can action this week:
- Share a POC requirements checklist and scoring rubric (attached).
- Draft a short SOW to capture timelines and responsibilities for both teams.
- Schedule a 30-min kickoff with your engineering and security folks to get the staging VPC details.

Can you confirm: 1) the dataset owners and a POC point of contact on your side, and 2) whether Nuvera is comfortable with our two-phase (offline then shadow) approach?

Thanks — Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | +1 (617) 555-0123

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Nuvera Health POC — evaluation approach, success gates, and owners

Claire / Hannah — quick technical notes and a suggested scoring rubric we attached (CSV):

1) Offline vs online: we agree with the two-phase approach. Practical recommendation: run the offline eval on the full 5k sample to detect model drift and edge-case failures, then use a 72-hour shadow with a 10% sampling of live traffic routed to the VPC mirror so we can validate stable precision/latency at scale.

2) Scoring components (proposed weights):
- Precision (urgent): 40%
- Recall (non-urgent): 25%
- Latency (p95 E2E on 256 tokens): 15%
- False positive operational impact (manual reviews triggered/day): 10%
- Observability & logging completeness (audit trails present): 10%

Pass threshold: weighted score >= 0.85 (85%). We will publish per-class confusion matrices and per-route cost estimates after each run.

3) Data handling: for offline runs we can accept a de‑identified dataset in CSV or NDJSON. For the shadow, we will deploy Redwood Private in your staging VPC and use network mirroring — no data will leave your VPC outside the agreed tunnels and HSM for keys if requested.

4) Timeline (draft):
- Kickoff / security review: Week of Sep 27
- Offline eval run: Oct 4–15 (two calendar weeks for labeling handoffs and checks)
- Shadow deploy & run: Oct 18–20 (72 hours)
- Post-POC review: Oct 22

I attached a draft scoring CSV and a short POc-ops checklist. Marissa — can you confirm CS ownership of the post-POC acceptance and any required handoffs for production rollout?

—Aditya
SE, Redwood Inference
